changeSet.sql: UPDATE issue SET review_snapshot_id = gen_random_uuid() WHERE issue_type = 'ISSUE'
UPDATE observation SET superseded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE artifact_kind = 'scm.issue'

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Allow a changed issue snapshot to stop feedback at delivery.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE feedback DROP CONSTRAINT chk_feedback_suppression_reason; ALTER TABLE feedback ADD CONSTRAINT chk_feedback_suppression_reason CHECK (suppression_reason IS NULL OR suppression_reason IN ( 'VOLUME_CAPPED', 'COMPOSER_DEDUPED', 'COMPOSER_WITHHELD', 'REACTED_DISPUTED', 'REACTED_NOT_APPLICABLE', 'CONVERSATION_EXPIRED', 'ARTIFACT_GONE', 'ARTIFACT_CLOSED', 'ISSUE_SNAPSHOT_CHANGED', 'ARTIFACT_MERGED', 'ARTIFACT_DRAFT', 'RECIPIENT_OPTED_OUT', 'EMPTY_AFTER_SANITIZE', 'INSTANCE_SILENCED', 'PRACTICE_REQUIRES_APPROVAL', 'BACKFILL_QUIET', 'WORKSPACE_DISABLED', 'APPROVAL_STALE', 'APPROVAL_NO_LONGER_ELIGIBLE', 'WORKSPACE_DELIVERY_PAUSED', 'STALE_ROLLOUT_REVISION', 'OUTSIDE_CURRENT_COVERAGE'));
